messages:
maria: Hey team, BrightCo reported an autopay failure this morning for invoice inv_8Y3... customer says card charged then immediately declined. I tried a manual retry from the console and got mixed signals. Can someone help triage?

dan: Can you paste the payment_id and the raw gateway response? Also which gateway is this routed to?

maria: payment_id: pay_01G7FZQ9. Routed via gateway: gateway-x (EU acquirer). Raw responses below: first attempt (autopay): `status: declined`, `decline_code: insufficient_funds (54)`, `network_response: issuer_declined`. Then automated retry (post-fail workflow) shows `3ds_required`, ACS challenge initiated, ACS responded with timeout (ACS_TIMEOUT). Console log: `POST /payments 200 -> attempt=1 status=declined code=54` then `retry_flow:start -> reroute=true` then `POST /payments 202 -> challenge_url` then `ACS timeout after 15s -> status=failed`

olivia: I pulled the billing audit for inv_8Y3... the retry logic tried a fresh authorization instead of resubmitting the original auth. For recurring autopay we should be performing a tokenized recurring auth (no 3DS). Looks like gateway-x flagged the token as uncategorized so it triggered a 3DS flow.

dan: Do we have the request payload for the retry attempt? Need to verify `recurring=true` header/param. If that was missing, gateway may treat as initial sale and require SCA.

maria: Retry payload (from support console):
```json
{
  "payment_method_token": "tok_cust_9ab",
  "amount": 14250,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "capture": true,
  "metadata": {"origin":"autopay_retry"}
}
```
No explicit `recurring` flag present.

kevin: That explains it. If the token isn't annotated as recurring on the gateway, it can trigger on-setup SCA. Why did our retry path omit the recurring flag? Could be a regression from the rollout last week where we refactored retry route code.

maria: Support console screenshot (omitted) shows the UI still marks the payment method as "tokenized - recurring". But the backend request omitted it.

dan: I'm going to repro in staging. Steps I'll run: 1) create test merchant with gateway-x sandbox token, 2) create invoice with autopay enabled, 3) simulate insufficient funds decline on initial auth, 4) let autopay retry run and inspect outgoing gateway API.

retry-bot: scheduled job autopay_retry_runner started for invoice inv_8Y3... run_id=rr_2021-03-15-09:22

olivia: Also FYI the gateway sent back `rate_limit` for one of the retry attempts earlier at 09:23:12 which led our retryer to switch to the fallback route. Fallback route reattempt did not include a recurring flag either. Gateway logs show `429` then `challenge_required`.

kevin: Two separate issues then: (A) missing recurring marker in retry/fallback payloads; (B) autopay should not fallback to a new initial-auth that triggers SCA — instead we should queue a manual follow-up or surface to merchant.

maria: Customer is upset; they lost service access. They want a quick remediation and a clear explanation for finance team. Any temporary mitigation?

dan: Temporary mitigation: re-run a tokenized recurring auth manually via payments team tooling (we can set `recurring=true` and use stored token), that should avoid SCA if gateway honors it. I'll try now and post results.

(monitoring output pasted) dan: Manual recurring retry result: `200 OK`, `status: authorized`, `auth_code: 89AKF`, `settlement_pending`. So manual fix works.

olivia: I'll update the invoice status to collected and notify BrightCo with the reconciliation note. Also propose we block automatic fallback-on-initial-auth for autopay flows until we patch.

kevin: I'll open an ENG bug (ENG-issue: 5983) to add tests and ensure retry code includes `recurring=true` and does not trigger fallback path that performs initial-auth. Can someone add repro steps and the failing request/response into the ticket?

maria: Adding logs to ENG-5983 now. Also customer wants a timeline; please mark priority P1 on the ticket.

dan: Assigned. Plan: patch retryer today -> hotfix to include recurring flag and guard against fallback initial-auths; add metric for autopay_3ds_rate.

olivia: Also will open a support KB entry explaining why autopay might prompt SCA and how we remediate.

maria: thanks all :raised_hands: I'll send the customer the manual-retry resolution and link to the follow-up ticket.
